agently.short_description: Choose the right design or implementation capability owner
agently.default_prompt: Use $agently to identify the task scope and route to the appropriate design or implementation skill.

agently-product-design.short_description: Design product journeys, interfaces and readable documents
agently-product-design.default_prompt: Use $agently-product-design to design the product, role journeys, interface or document and verify the affected outcomes.

agently-agentic-design.short_description: Design and audit Agentic service responsibilities and flows
agently-agentic-design.default_prompt: Use $agently-agentic-design to review model and Host responsibilities, data flow, lifecycle and evidence for this service.

agently-request.short_description: Configure model requests, prompts and structured results
agently-request.default_prompt: Use $agently-request to configure this model request, its prompt, output contract and response consumption.

agently-runtime.short_description: Connect execution, tools, resources and service adapters
agently-runtime.default_prompt: Use $agently-runtime to choose the runtime, tool, resource or service adapter that owns this capability.

agently-stage.short_description: Manage task lifetimes and safe sync/async bridges
agently-stage.default_prompt: Use $agently-stage to choose the correct task-lifetime, sync/async bridge, stream or event pattern.

agently-triggerflow.short_description: Build explicit branching, concurrent and resumable workflows
agently-triggerflow.default_prompt: Use $agently-triggerflow to implement the explicit branching, concurrency, waiting and recovery required by this workflow.

agently-migration.short_description: Map existing model workflows to Agently capability owners
agently-migration.default_prompt: Use $agently-migration to map this existing model application to Agently owners while preserving its required behavior.

agently-collaboration.short_description: Explain tasks, progress, decisions and handoffs clearly
agently-collaboration.default_prompt: Use $agently-collaboration to explain the current task and outcome, maintain its complete plan and report meaningful progress.

agently.short_description: 判断任务与项目形态，选择合适的设计或实现技能并协调专业职责归属
agently.default_prompt: 使用 $agently 判断任务范围和项目形态，选择合适的设计或实现技能。

agently-product-design.short_description: 从真实场景设计方案、角色行为、应用体验和文档表达，逐项修订并验证
agently-product-design.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-product-design 从真实场景设计方案、角色行为、应用体验或文档，并验证受影响的结果。

agently-agentic-design.short_description: 设计和审查模型与应用的职责、数据流、证据、生命周期及并发执行边界
agently-agentic-design.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-agentic-design 审查模型与应用的职责、数据流、生命周期和证据，明确设计与验证边界。

agently-request.short_description: 配置模型请求、提示词、结构化输出、流式响应、记忆与检索的使用契约
agently-request.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-request 配置本次模型请求、提示词、输出契约及响应消费方式。

agently-runtime.short_description: 接入执行插件、工具、资源、工作文件、服务适配和观测能力并核对边界
agently-runtime.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-runtime 选择承接本次能力的运行时、工具、资源或服务适配方式，并核对职责边界。

agently-stage.short_description: 管理进程内任务生命周期、同步异步桥接、事件、流及清理与并发边界
agently-stage.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-stage 选择适合本场景的任务生命周期、同步异步桥接、事件或流处理方式。

agently-triggerflow.short_description: 构建可检查的分支、并发、等待、恢复和重试工作流，明确状态与执行职责
agently-triggerflow.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-triggerflow 实现本工作流所需的显式分支、并发、等待与恢复，并验证执行状态。

agently-migration.short_description: 将现有模型应用映射到 Agently 的请求、运行时和编排能力，保留原有行为
agently-migration.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-migration 将现有模型应用映射到 Agently 的能力归属，保留原有行为并核对迁移证据。

agently-collaboration.short_description: 先讲清当前任务与核心进展，分层表达成果，维护完整任务板、决策和交接
agently-collaboration.default_prompt: 使用 $agently-collaboration 讲清当前任务与核心进展，维护完整任务板，分层说明成果、依据和下一步。
